Class FieldMappingEngine.MapRecordResult

public class FieldMappingEngine.MapRecordResult

Wrapper class that encapsulates the result of a field mapping operation. Contains the mapped SObject record, its type information, and validation status indicating whether the mapping succeeded or failed due to required field violations or validation formula failures.
